news.title: Rajinikanth's Dharman Eyes a Major Pongal 2027 Arrival
news.summary: Superstar Rajinikanth's upcoming film Dharman, directed by Ashwath Marimuthu and backed by Kamal Haasan's Raaj Kamal Films International, is currently in fast-paced production. The family-oriented thriller features an ensemble cast including Simran, Raashii Khanna, and Ram Pothineni in a pivotal role. The makers are officially targeting a theatrical release during the Pongal 2027 festival window.

news.title: Speculation Rises Around Mahesh Babu's Next Cinematic Venture
news.summary: As Mahesh Babu wraps up his portions for SS Rajamouli's highly anticipated Varanasi, rumors regarding his next collaboration have begun swirling. While filmmakers like Buchi Babu Sana and Sandeep Reddy Vanga have been linked to the superstar, recent talks between Lokesh Kanagaraj's production banner and Mythri Movie Makers have sparked fresh fan speculation. However, no official actor-director pairing between Mahesh and Lokesh has been confirmed yet.

news.title: Nani and Srikanth Odela Clarify Trolled Dialogue in The Paradise
news.summary: Actor Nani and director Srikanth Odela addressed criticism surrounding a specific dialogue in their recent release, The Paradise, where a character is labeled a single-take artist. The director explained that the line was intended to be ironic, but essential backstory explaining the moment was cut during editing to manage runtime. Meanwhile, the action drama continues its strong box-office run, nearing the 150 crore gross milestone.

news.title: Taapsee Pannu Serves Striking Retro Looks in Latest Photoshoot
news.summary: Actress Taapsee Pannu recently stunned fans by sharing pictures from a bold retro-themed photoshoot featuring voluminous curls and a vintage wardrobe. On the professional front, the actress is currently filming Woh Ladki Hai Kahaan?, where she portrays ACP Komal Sharma. Her latest stylish appearance arrives following a challenging box-office phase earlier in the year.

news.title: Sai Durga Tej Starrer Sambarala Yeti Gattu to Keep Its Sankranti Date
news.summary: Despite overlapping box-office competition announcements for the Sankranti festival season, the creators of Sambarala Yeti Gattu have decided to maintain their original release schedule. Producer Chaitanya Reddy confirmed that filming is complete and post-production work is nearing its final stage. The action entertainer directed by Rohith KP stars Sai Durga Tej alongside Aishwarya Lekshmi, Jagapathi Babu, and Srikanth.

news.title: NTR Set to Restart Filming for Dragon in Mumbai
news.summary: Actor NTR is preparing to return to the sets of Dragon following a recovery break from a shoulder injury. Director Prashanth Neel has continued filming other sequences in the meantime, while a new two-week schedule featuring high-voltage action stunts will begin in Mumbai on October 10. The project is backed by Mythri Movie Makers and NTR Arts, featuring a cast that includes Rukmini Vasanth and Anil Kapoor.

news.title: Anil Ravipudi's January 12 Vidudala Nears Completion
news.summary: Director Anil Ravipudi is swiftly wrapping up production for his upcoming directorial venture, January 12 Vidudala. Following a brief intermission, the team will resume shooting in Ooty during the first week of October to film remaining sequences and overseas songs. The movie features Venkatesh, Kalyanram, Keerthy Suresh, and Krithi Shetty in lead roles, with music composed by GV Prakash Kumar.

news.title: Nani's The Paradise Maintains Strong Momentum at the Box Office
news.summary: The Srikanth Odela directorial venture, The Paradise, has recorded strong and steady earnings on its third day following a record-breaking opening for lead actor Nani. Family crowds and general audiences turned up in large numbers over the holiday weekend, resulting in robust advance bookings. Produced by Sudhakar Cherukuri, the movie showcases massive theatrical euphoria and stellar audience reception.

news.title: Chakkora Trailer Unveils a Blend of Romance and Mystery
news.summary: The theatrical trailer for Chakkora – Lunar Love Bird has been officially unveiled, showcasing a unique mix of romance, family dynamics, and suspense. The plot follows a carefree young man whose life turns upside down when his love interest suddenly vanishes, setting off a gripping search for the truth. Directed by debutant Manga Srinivas, the movie is scheduled for an international theatrical release in October.

news.title: Fresh Visuals from Nitesh Tiwari's Ramayana Highlight Scale and Mythology
news.summary: Makers of the ambitious mythological project Ramayana have released striking new stills featuring the principal cast, including Ranbir Kapoor, Sai Pallavi, and Yash. The newly revealed promotional material emphasizes divine aesthetics, intricate character designs, and grand backdrops. Part 1 of the epic feature is slated to hit screens during Diwali 2026.

news.title: Chakkora Promotional Trailer Highlights Youthful Drama and Suspense
news.summary: The upcoming Telugu film Chakkora has released its promotional trailer, introducing viewers to a vibrant romance that takes a mysterious turn. Starring Sravan and Malaika T. Vasupal, the narrative pivots from lighthearted college antics into an emotional investigation following a sudden disappearance. Backed by vibrant visuals and an atmospheric score, the project prepares for its worldwide arrival.

news.title: Nani's The Paradise Maintains Strong Box Office Momentum Over Opening Weekend
news.summary: Despite receiving mixed initial reviews and taking a risk with an early weekday premiere, Nani's starrer The Paradise has continued to pull solid numbers at the box office. The production banner reported a worldwide gross of 136 crore rupees in its first three days, fueled by growing ticket sales in the Telugu states and robust overseas earnings. The core team recently gathered for a success celebration following the unexpected weekend surge.

news.title: NTR Set to Resume Shooting for Dragon in Mumbai Following Recovery
news.summary: Actor NTR is preparing to head back to work for his upcoming pan-India project Dragon after recovering from a shoulder injury and subsequent surgery. The upcoming 15-day schedule in Mumbai begins on October 10 and will feature high-octane action sequences with NTR and Anil Kapoor. Directed by Prashanth Neel and produced by Mythri Movie Makers, the film is currently slated for a theatrical release in June 2027.

news.title: Nani Starrer The Paradise Faces Crucial Box Office Test on Monday
news.summary: Nani's big-budget release The Paradise opened to strong box office numbers despite receiving mixed reviews from audiences and critics regarding its emotional depth and screenplay. Trade estimates indicate the movie grossed around ₹120 crore by Saturday and aims toward a target of ₹220 crore. With no major competing releases arriving next week, its performance on Monday will be pivotal in determining its long-term financial viability.

news.title: Makers of Ramayana Unveil Striking New Character Posters Ahead of Diwali Releases
news.summary: The ambitious cinematic adaptation Ramayana has released two fresh character posters showcasing Yash as a regal Ravana and the divine trio of Ram, Lakshmana, and Sita. Directed by Nitesh Tiwari and produced on a global scale by Namit Malhotra and Monster Mind Creations, the project features music composed by AR Rahman and Hans Zimmer. The two-part film is scheduled to hit theaters during Diwali 2026 and Diwali 2027.

news.title: Special Character Teaser Planned to Introduce Tabu in Nagarjuna's King100
news.summary: The production team behind Nagarjuna Akkineni's milestone film King100 is gearing up to release a special promotional video introducing Tabu's character. This project marks a reunion for Nagarjuna and Tabu, who previously starred together in the 1990s hit Ninne Pelladutha. Directed by Ra Karthik and backed by Annapurna Studios and Manam Enterprises, the movie is scheduled to open in cinemas on December 24, 2026.

news.title: Vijay Deverakonda's Historical Drama Gets a Special Promotional Documentary
news.summary: To build anticipation for Rahul Sankrityan's upcoming directorial Ranabaali, the makers are launching a four-part promotional documentary series titled Ranabaali: Never Forget. The project highlights two years of research into a forgotten chapter of Rayalaseema history concerning British suppression during a famine. The film stars Vijay Deverakonda in the lead and is backed by Mythri Movie Makers, featuring music by Ajay-Atul.

news.title: BRS Leader KTR Praises Nani and Srikanth Odela's The Paradise
news.summary: BRS Working President KTR caught a screening of Nani's action-drama The Paradise at Hyderabad's Sudarshan Theatre alongside various public representatives. He commended the cast, director Srikanth Odela, and the crew for creating an authentic visual depiction of Telangana's cultural identity and language. Furthermore, he lauded how effectively the movie portrays the collective struggle and resistance of an oppressed community against threats to their existence.

news.title: Industry Reports Highlight Rashmika Mandanna's Strong OTT Market Standing
news.summary: Recent trade buzz indicates that digital platforms are reportedly willing to offer higher valuations for female-centric projects led by Rashmika Mandanna compared to Sai Pallavi. Industry insiders attribute this difference to Rashmika's involvement in major pan-Indian blockbusters like Pushpa 2, Animal, and Chhaava, alongside her massive social media presence. This strong digital pull is further underscored by a reported streaming deal closed for her upcoming MS Subbulakshmi biopic.

news.title: Nani Starrer The Paradise Maintains Steady Ticket Sales on Day Three
news.summary: Despite mixed initial reviews, the Nani-led film The Paradise continues to perform strongly at the box office. On its third day, the movie recorded 252K ticket sales on BookMyShow, matching its second-day momentum. Directed by Srikanth Odela and produced by Sudhakar Cherukuri, the project has drawn significant attention from fans and trade analysts alike.

news.title: Wildcard Entrant Mithilesh Exits Bigg Boss Telugu Season Ten With Cash Offer
news.summary: In a surprising development on Bigg Boss Telugu Season 10, wildcard contestant Mithilesh chose to exit the house after just one day. He accepted a tempting fifteen lakh rupees cash offer extended by Bigg Boss. Mithilesh defended his choice by stating that changing house equations made winning impossible for him.

news.title: Actor Nani Calls The Paradise a Long-Distance Runner at Hyderabad Press Meet
news.summary: During a recent media interaction in Hyderabad for The Paradise, lead actor Nani expressed joy over audiences eventually embracing the film despite early negative talk. He praised the relentless dedication of the entire crew, director Srikanth Odela, and technicians like Anirudh and editor Navin Nooli. Nani described the project as a horse built for the long run.

news.title: Mohan Babu Calls His Role in The Paradise the Deadliest of His Half-Century Career
news.summary: Veteran actor Mohan Babu attended a press meet for The Paradise in Hyderabad, where he praised director Srikanth Odela and producer Sudhakar Cherukuri. He revealed that his character in the film is the most dangerous role he has undertaken in his fifty-year cinematic journey. Mohan Babu also lauded Nani's phenomenal acting and tremendous hard work on set.

news.title: Nani Highlights Unusual Box Office Journey For The Paradise
news.summary: Actor Nani shared that his upcoming project, The Paradise, witnessed a rare upward trajectory where audience reception improved steadily from negative to positive with each subsequent screening. Directed by Srikanth Odela and backed by producer Sudhakar Cherukuri, the film features an ensemble cast including Mohan Babu, Raghav Juyal, Sonali Kulkarni, and Kayadu Lohar.
